The main purpose of this system is to ensure that the billing process is completed correctly. Data received from contracts and orders will be taken into account when invoicing. Therefore, both of these components are necessary for the correct execution of the process.

I would like to be able to enter a discount from Obligations to Society tax so that I can keep track of the point of delivery, customer and the relevant period for which such discount is applicable.. („Discount from Obligations to Society tax“ Functionality)

The Discount , element of Bundle 3, combines a comprehensive definition of its parameters and details. In the context of Phoenix system, 'Discount' refers to ENERGY-PRO's offerings for Bulgaria, such as electricity delivery and its associated parameters.

 

From date - date when the discount becomes active

To date - date when the discount will end

Certificate Number - It is mandatory to define the certificate number in order to create invoice with correct number

Amount of discount in % - Informational field which will not be a part of discount calculation process

Amount of discount in money per kWh - The amount of discount in money, represents the reduction in the original price.

For example, let's say the original price per kWh is 0.15, and there's a amount of discount in money per kWh 0.03 per kWh:

Original Price per kWh = 0.15 per kWh Discounted Price per kWh = 0.15 per kWh - 0.03 per kWh = 0.12 per kWh

Customer - the customer for whom the discount will be valid

Point of delivery - the Point of delivery for which the discount will be valid. There is no need to have a connection between POD and Customer

For example:

  1. We added a customer sub object, which is called Zauri
    After this, we have added a POD that is associated with another customer, which is called Giorgi.

output : we will able to create discount

During Discount creation:

  • When creating a Discount , it is mandatory to complete all required fields across the three tabs.

    • After clicking the 'Create' button, the system should check frontend validation, and if an error is detected, it should be displayed in the proper field.

    • In the event of a backend error (after successful frontend validation), the system also displays an error message.

 

During Discount editing:

  • When editing a Discount, there are two options:

    • Updating the current version

      • 'Discount' has only current version

  • On editing mode, while creating a update version, system should copy all the objects from the previous version.

  • In editing mode, all fields are available to edit.
